section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes a study conducted in Jakarta, Indonesia, where participants were recruited via convenience sampling from public locations such as marketplaces and shopping complexes. Participants completed a paper-and-pencil survey on a voluntary basis and returned it in a sealed envelope to ensure confidentiality and anonymity. The section does not specify the sample size, participant demographics, assessment instruments, or study design details.
